answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold blocks bulk fakes. A new agent must trade with 20 counterparties for full rewards, at most two per referral cluster, and a graph audit flags star clusters. Partners must differ: a workshop on a mesa, a dock ruled by the tide, a depot past a dune. Forging 1,000 identities needs 20,000 trades; at $2 each that is $40,000 against $3,000 of rewards. An honest agent pays for 20 trades once, keeping earnings undiluted.
